module: "gameplaySelector" backend of the grid selector: the screen that lists missions, scenarios, campaigns, quick-start experiences and rally selectors. It collects the tiles through the hook onGameplaySelectorGetTiles (validBackends must contain gameplaySelector), handles filters, search, favorites, recents and display options (saved in /settings/gameplaySelectorData.json), builds the details via onGameplaySelectorGetDetails and sends snapshots to the interface (GameplaySelectorDataLoaded, gameplaySelectorDisplayDataSnapshot, gameplaySelectorDetails). It also applies presets according to the route (menu.gameplay, menu.rallySelector, menu.experiencesSelector) and handles navigation to "clusters".
usage:
-- open the rally selector (applies the rallyStage and rallyLoop filters)
ui_gameplaySelector_general.openRallySelector()
notes: Routes handled: menu.gameplay (and menu.gameplay.type for a cluster), menu.rallySelector, menu.experiencesSelector (and menu.experiencesSelector.type). For rally, groupMode and clusterMode come from groupModeRally (default "type") and clusterModeRally (default "none"); for experiences, groupMode is "system" and clusterMode "automatic".
The route presets (GAMEPLAY_ROUTE_PRESETS) clear filters and search then enable the quickStartExperiences system (experiences) or the types bigMap.missionLabels.rallyStage and rallyLoop (rally).

When a route is mounted, the heavy loading goes through util_asyncBulkLoader.loadGameplaySelector; the snapshot is only emitted at the end (hook asyncGameplaySelectorLoadComplete) and only if the current route is still the requested one. Without asyncBulkLoader, or if it answers "alreadyLoaded", the snapshot is emitted right away.

The data is recomputed on next access after onModActivated, onModDeactivated, onModManagerReady, onModManagerStateChanged or onSettingsChanged. Unlike the freeroam backend, onLanguageChanged is not listened to here.
Several functions accept an optional requestId: if provided, a snapshot is emitted so that the interface ignores stale responses. clearAllFilters does not have this parameter.

Display options: groupMode, clusterMode, groupModeRally, clusterModeRally, displaySize, showAuxContent, showCareerContent (false by default), sorting, showRecentMode, showFavouritesMode, defaultFreeroamAction. The data version is 12.
The "system" filter offers quick values: quickStartExperiences, challenges, scenarios, scenariosMultiplayer and, outside the simplified menu, campaigns.
Debug left in the code: navigateToCluster and onClusterRouteMount call dump(), and the steps of the asynchronous mount write with print().

Inconsistencies in range filtering: the test "not type(propVal) == 'number'" is always false because of the precedence of not (it should be type(propVal) ~= 'number'), and an assignment propVal = item[propKey] is repeated with no effect in the filter creation.
exploreFolder, goToMod, closedFromUI, exitCallback and profilerFinish are shells (log or TODO); getManagementDetails always returns { buttons = {} }.
The field M.displayDataInstance is exposed after the first initialization.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one: ui_gameplaySelector_tiles and core_locales.

getUiData.desc: Returns the selector data: items, displayData (adapted to the route: rally or experiences), filterList, activeFilters, lockedFiltersByProp and backendName. Loads the tiles if needed.

routeName.desc: Route name, to adapt groupMode and clusterMode.

getGameplayData.desc: Returns the selector data (tiles whose validBackends contains gameplaySelector, filters, display options), recomputes them if the mods or settings have changed, and creates them on first request.

returns.desc: Table items, filterList, activeFilters, lockedFiltersByProp, displayData.

isGameplayDataLoaded.desc: Indicates whether the data has already been built and is up to date.

returns.desc: True if loaded and not invalidated (nil or false otherwise).

getTiles.desc: Returns the tile groups for a path, via ui_gameplaySelector_tiles.getTiles.

navigateToCluster.desc: Prepares then opens a tile cluster's screen. Computes the path keys (gotoPath, keys or the table itself) and a title, stores the pending selection and navigates to menu.gameplay.type (or menu.experiencesSelector.type from the experiences selector).

input.desc: Tile or path table: gotoPath, keys, or list of keys; name, label or title for the title.

requestDetails.desc: Builds a tile's details and sends them to the interface via the event gameplaySelectorDetails with backendName, requestId, item and details.

passesFilters.desc: Indicates whether a tile passes the filters and the search; an isCareerOnly tile is refused as long as displayData.showCareerContent is false.

returns.desc: true if the tile is displayed.

getDisplayData.desc: Returns the effective display options, adapted to the route (rally or experiences).

updateFilterData.desc: Updates an internal datum of the filters module (filterInstance.updateData).

isFavourite.desc: Indicates whether a tile is a favorite.

toggleFavourite.desc: Toggles a tile's favorite status and returns the new state.

isRecent.desc: Indicates whether a tile is among the recent items.

trackRecent.desc: Records a tile as recently used.

getFilters.desc: Returns the filter definition after loading the data.

toggleFilter.desc: Enables or disables a filter value. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

updateRangeFilter.desc: Sets the bounds of a range filter. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

resetRangeFilter.desc: Resets a range filter. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

resetSetFilter.desc: Resets a multiple-choice filter. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

setSearchText.desc: Sets the search text. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

getDisplayDataOptions.desc: Returns the display options definition adapted to the route: hides groupMode and clusterMode in rally or experiences mode, and hides groupModeRally and clusterModeRally elsewhere.

routeName.desc: Route name (the active route by default).

setDisplayDataOption.desc: Sets a display option and returns the updated display data. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

resetDisplayDataToDefaults.desc: Resets the display options to their default values. Emits a snapshot if requestId is provided.

getScreenHeaderTitleAndPath.desc: Builds the screen title and the breadcrumb (menu, gameplay selector, filters or search segment, cluster or discover page). Adds "(filtered)" to the title if filters or a search are active.

closedFromUI.desc: Called when the interface closes the selector. Does nothing for now (TODO).

getDetails.desc: Builds a tile's details by emitting the hook onGameplaySelectorGetDetails and returns the first block.

returns.desc: Details block, nil if no generator responded.

executeButton.desc: Runs the details button with the given identifier via the buttonModule.

additionalData.desc: Extra data passed to the callback.

getManagementDetails.desc: Always returns { buttons = {} } (TODO in the code).

executeDoubleClick.desc: Runs the button marked isDoubleClickAction in a tile's details (or the only button if there is just one).

goToMod.desc: Only logs the mod id (not implemented).

asyncGameplaySelectorLoadComplete.desc: End hook of the asynchronous loading (util_asyncBulkLoader). Emits the GameplaySelectorDataLoaded snapshot of the pending route, unless the user changed route in the meantime.

resolveCurrentSelectorPath.desc: Returns the current view's path: that of the active cluster, otherwise the root path { keys = {"allGameplay"} }.

emitDisplayDataSnapshot.desc: Rebuilds the current view's snapshot (groups, filters, display options, management details, search text, header) and sends it via the event gameplaySelectorDisplayDataSnapshot with the requestId. Returns false and logs an error on failure.

returns.desc: true if the event was sent.

onRouteMount.desc: Route hook called when a root route of the selector is mounted. Resets the cluster selection, stores the active route and starts the asynchronous loading with the allGameplay path.

onClusterRouteEnter.desc: Route hook called on entering a cluster route. Promotes the selection prepared by navigateToCluster, otherwise falls back to the default cluster.

onClusterRouteMount.desc: Route hook called when a cluster route is mounted. Starts the asynchronous loading with the active cluster's keys and title.

resolveClusterTitle.desc: Returns the active cluster's title, otherwise clusterTitle if it is a non-empty string, otherwise nil.

openGameplaySelector.desc: Applies the preset of the menu.gameplay route (clears filters and search) then navigates to it.

openRallySelector.desc: Opens menu.rallySelector with the type filters rallyStage and rallyLoop.

openExperiencesSelector.desc: Opens menu.experiencesSelector with the system filter quickStartExperiences.

onModDeactivated.desc: Hook called when a mod is deactivated: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onModActivated.desc: Hook called when a mod is activated: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onModManagerReady.desc: Hook called when the mod manager is ready: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onModManagerStateChanged.desc: Hook called when the mod manager state changes: marks the data as needing recomputation.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when the settings change: marks the data as needing recomputation.
